title: On a phone the + and the remove x work without hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: On a phone, you split an open work order's representative into Labor and Parts and then remove Parts again.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it.
  2. Tap the + button.
  3. Tap "Sales Representative - Parts".
  4. Tap the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card expands; the + button shows beside the Sales Representative field at its full size, without any hover.
  • Step 2: a menu opens.
  • Step 3: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" show, both reading {Sales-rep-A}, each with its arrow showing; the remove x shows beside Parts.
  • Step 4: one "Sales Representative" field shows again, reading {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S2-R6: “Both fields start with the person who was in the one field, or "Unassigned" if it was empty. Adding the Parts field on its own changes nobody's credit.”
  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
